disposition_reason: Original GF-AAS measurements of lead, cadmium and arsenic in 20 composite samples of five wastewater-irrigated vegetables; the filed PDF is the Research Square preprint.

study.design: Field sampling of five vegetables from a wastewater-irrigated agribelt with probabilistic risk assessment (preprint)
study.origin: Zabol agribelt, Sistan-Baluchestan Province, Iran; irrigated with secondary-treated municipal wastewater
study.method: GF-AAS (Shimadzu AA-7000) after EPA 3051A microwave-assisted acid digestion; samples washed, dried 65 °C 48 h, ground
study.qa: NIST SRM 1570a spinach leaves, recoveries Pb 94±2%, Cd 91±3%, As 92±4%; RSD Pb 8.5%, Cd 11.2%, As 12.8%

Summary text gives Pb mean 1.615 ± 0.640 (n=20), Cd 0.103 ± 0.072 (n=10), As 0.066 ± 0.115 (n=6) with unexplained n; not extracted.
Text gives leek Cd 0.075±0.020 and Fig. 2 legend values that differ slightly from Table 1; Table 1 used.
Several Cd and As values are below the stated LOQ but printed as numbers.
Soil background values are not food findings.
